summary: Line-by-line audit of main_ui.py and its wiring to pipeline.py. Found 16 UI bugs: missing subprocess import, missing status mappings for gpu_diarizing and gpu_faceswap, dead download link, settings.json CWD mismatch, broken Mark Start/End buttons, stale Gradio 6.0 CSS parameter, missing error display for failed jobs, preview player wiring broken, no target_language or low_vram_mode settings controls, and more.
